name: Terminal Illness
overview: Scripture teaches that facing terminal illness calls for courage and trust in God's faithful presence, as He promises never to forsake His people (Deuteronomy 31:6, Isaiah 41:10). In times of distress, believers are encouraged to cry out to the Lord, confident that He hears and responds (Psalms 18:6). While suffering and weeping may endure temporarily, God’s favor brings life and joy beyond the night of affliction (Psalms 30:5). Ultimately, God’s timing governs all seasons of life, and those who wait on Him will find renewed strength to endure without fainting (Ecclesiastes 3:1, Isaiah 40:31).
